scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w @planner/core && npm run db:generate
scripts.dev: concurrently -n core,api,web -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w @planner/core" "npm run dev -w @planner/api" "npm run dev -w @planner/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @planner/core && npm run build -w @planner/api && npm run build -w @planner/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @planner/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
